description: Main-pass correction after the WPN-first Turn Zero/CoreTCG/Aki/ProjectCCG event batch. Captures ProjectCCG Discord as inspected community evidence, adds a Santa Ana Places evaluation, improves Alhambra and Turn Zero assessment notes, and preserves Turn Zero Canadian Highlander as a material event/community TBD rather than over-projecting an every-other-Saturday calendar row. No schema/auth/RLS/app code or canonical JSON changes are proposed.
author: Codex Project Steward

operations.reason: Make the proxy-friendly Canadian Highlander signal visible as Evidence without over-projecting it into the calendar.
Turn Zero Linktree was rechecked; it still routes to official website, Discord, and card-selling surfaces, but its linked current schedule image currently behaves as a stale/dead schedule surface.

fields.assessment_notes: Turn Zero Games remains one of the clearest Magic-focused LA stores in the dataset. Official Linktree still routes to website, Discord, and card-selling intake and advertises the Discord community, but the linked current schedule image is stale/dead in this pass. Wizards/EventLink already supports Commander, FNM Modern, and future prerelease coverage. Canlandex adds a material Canadian Highlander signal: every-other-Saturday 1:00 PM play with a Discord route, which is especially relevant because it points to proxy-friendly competitive-casual Magic. Do not normalize that as a weekly calendar row without a biweekly-safe representation or dated confirmation. Treat Turn Zero as a strong watch/possible-try store, with Discord/content replay still the next decision-changing check for solo arrival and Commander texture.

operations.reason: Reflect the corrected source-routing read and preserve the Canadian Highlander signal without polluting the calendar.

positives: Official Linktree supports strong source routing to website, Discord, and store intake surfaces.
Wizards/EventLink supports Commander, FNM Modern, and future prerelease coverage.
Canlandex supports an every-other-Saturday Canadian Highlander signal with proxy-friendly competitive-casual relevance.
Review-derived evidence continues to support active tables, free play space, beginner support, and a sizable Magic community.
cautions: Distance from Los Alamitos makes this worthwhile mainly if the community/event fit proves strong.
The linked current schedule image from Linktree appears stale/dead in this pass.
Canadian Highlander is not Commander and should not be over-weighted as direct Commander fit.
Discord content has not been inspected in this pass, so LFG, proxy norms for Commander, and solo-arrival mechanics remain unresolved.
open_questions: Does the Turn Zero Discord have usable LFG or Commander coordination for solo arrivals?
Is Commander casual, competitive, or mixed in practice?
Can the Canadian Highlander cadence be represented safely as dated future occurrences or a biweekly recurrence?

operations.reason: Slightly improve Turn Zero's planning read from the Canadian Highlander and source-routing signals while preserving the unresolved Discord/Commander texture.

fields.assessment_notes: ProjectCCG - Santa Ana / OC now reads as a strong nearby Magic planning candidate rather than just an identity/status record. Wizards/EventLink supports multiple active MTG lanes: Tuesday and Friday Commander, Sunday Commander, Sunday Draft, and Tuesday/Friday Standard Showdown. The inspected ProjectCCG Discord materially improves confidence: it is a real ProjectCCG two-store community with branch-specific OC channels, OC staff announcements, OC event posts, MTG announcements, same-week Standard/Commander discussion, and July 18 Commander pod interest. The Discord also shows store-operation corrections and closures, making it useful for reliability checks. The main limits are ordinary fit details: proxy friendliness, pod formation, and casual-versus-competitive Commander texture still need deeper Discord/player replay before treating it as a sure try.

operations.reason: Promote the Santa Ana branch from identity-only notes to a planning-quality Places assessment using inspected Discord and existing WPN event coverage.

positives: Close enough to be practical at about 13.4 miles from Los Alamitos.
Wizards/EventLink supports several active MTG lanes: Commander, Draft, and Standard Showdown.
Discord first pass shows a real branch-specific OC community route with staff announcements, OC event posts, and MTG discussion.
MTG discussion was active in the same week, including Standard locals chatter and a July 18 Commander pod signal.
Discord appears useful for operational reliability because staff announce closures, schedule changes, and event updates there.
cautions: Discord first pass supports activity and coordination, but not yet proxy policy, pod-formation mechanics, or solo-arrival comfort.
The same-week Discord closure notes show the branch is operationally communicative, but also reinforce the need to check Discord before traveling.
Sunday Commander versus Sunday Draft/Commander-draft wording needs continued care because the source surfaces can describe overlapping Sunday Magic lanes.
open_questions: Are Tuesday/Friday/Sunday Commander pods casual, competitive, or mixed?
Are proxies acceptable in Commander, and are pods formed in a way that works for solo arrival?
Does Sunday 4 PM function as ordinary Commander, draft, Commander draft, or multiple concurrent lanes?
Should the ProjectCCG Discord become a regular monitoring source for same-week changes?

fields.assessment_notes: ProjectCCG - Alhambra remains the main ProjectCCG storefront identity from the official website and WPN store 15983. WPN supports free Wednesday 5:00 PM Magic Commander Night at Alhambra. The inspected ProjectCCG Discord supports a real two-store community route, but this bounded read was more OC-specific than Alhambra-specific; Alhambra should therefore keep a conservative discovery-level status until branch-specific social, Discord, review, and in-store texture are replayed. Treat Alhambra as real and active, but less immediately practical than Santa Ana because of distance and thinner branch-specific fit evidence.
